title: Preschool Assessment
before:
Students in a public preschool classroom must have their growth and development formally assessed in a manner that is developmentally appropriate and based on observation.

Below is a list of commonly purchased assessment tools

  • Teaching Strategies Gold
  • Child Observation Record
  • The Work Sampling System

notes: 1 section header — too few for a contents list.

decisions.label: Set an over-long heading as the paragraph it is
decisions.why: 1 heading runs past 100 characters — the longest here is 171. "Students in a public preschool classroom must have their…" is body text that was set as a heading to make it stand out, so it is announced as a section of the page and, at h2, written into the contents list as a link. It becomes a paragraph. Any anchor on it is kept, so existing links still land, and not a word changes.

decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 1 heading sits at a level the page never opens — "Resources" is an h5 with no h4 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 1 heading is plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Write the email addresses the same way
decisions.why: 1 address is shown in whatever case it was typed in. The house form capitalises each name and leaves a middle initial in lower case — nicole.madore@maine.gov → Nicole.Madore@maine.gov. Only the first letter of each part changes, so a name that spells itself LaBreck keeps doing so.

decisions.label: Set a job title the way the rest of the site does
decisions.why: 1 job title sits in plain text under the person's name, where 186 elsewhere on the site are in italics — so the same contact block is drawn two ways depending on the page, and the title runs into the name above it. The standard here is the site's own, not a preference: two thirds of these blocks already do it. No word changes.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
decisions.value: Students in a public preschool classroom must have their growth and development formally assessed in a manner that is developmentally appropriate and based on observation.

decisions.label: Bring every heading up to h3 or above
decisions.why: 1 heading sat at h4 or deeper inside a card, a callout, a contact block or an accordion panel — components the outline walk leaves alone because they label a thing rather than a section. A reader using a screen reader still hears the level, so a fourth-level title inside a page that only goes to three is announced as belonging to a level that does not exist. Each is styled by its class and its position rather than its number, so nothing changes on screen.
